answer: Each epoch a marble draw scatters identities into random trios of strangers, linked by a thread; no one chooses its trio. Members send partners a signed pulse of work, earning only if both countersign. A clone farm cannot pick partners, so faking one means owning both strangers in its trio; redrawn each epoch, 10,000 clones land mostly beside honest strangers who refuse. Each pulse costs 4 POA burned; each attested pulse earns 9 POA. A fake costs 4 POA for 0, so 10,000 fakes burn 40,000 POA for nothing. The draw seed stays in a vault until lock-in; if it leaks early, the epoch is void.
